entities.summary: Hologram is a Mexican luchador enmascarado. He is signed to All Elite Wrestling (AEW), where he is a member of The Conglomeration. He also makes appearances for Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL). He is known for his time as Aramís with Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide (AAA) and International Wrestling Revolution Group. As Aramís, he participated in Pro Wrestling Guerrilla's Battle of Los Angeles 2019 event, which was his United States debut.
